pieces.Text: You summon a bridge of shimmering moonlight. The 10-foot-wide span touches the ground at a point adjacent to your position. From this point it can extend in any direction for
feet. The path persists until you have crossed over the bridge or for 24 hours, whichever is shorter. You may summon a moonlight bridge
times per day. Should the bridge be attacked, treat it as a wall of force.
